annotations.title: Verify that a quote appears on a web page

description: Checks a quote on its live page: exact, fuzzy or none, offsets and a signed receipt. US$0.01 per call; POST url, quote. Costs US$0.01 per call in USDC via x402 (Base), charged when the call answers below 400 (a no-match or not-found result is charged too); a bad request is refused unpaid. Pay by putting an x402 payment payload in _meta["x402/payment"]. Without one it returns the payment requirements. Docs: https://vehcdj664efetfrsolne5umanq.srv.us/docs/verify-quote

examples.quote: These domains may be used as illustrative examples in documents

case_sensitive.description: Default false; must be false with match "passages".

match.description: exact; fuzzy (default), which also accepts small differences; or passages, for a paraphrased claim: the 3 passages that share most of its words, scored, as evidence for you to judge (not a verdict).

quote.description: Text to look for on the page, or with match "passages" the claim to find support for (max 1,000 characters after normalisation).

url.description: http(s) URL of the page to check (max 2,048 characters). The whole request body is capped at 64 KB.

name: attestpage_verify_quote

page.description: Page verdict and evidence, including server_ip, tls and headers (the network evidence also signed into the receipt; null on an edge server).

result.description: match, score, start, end, context, occurrences, normalised_sha256; on a none, nearest (the closest span: start, end, text, score, diff; charged like any answer); with match "passages" also passages [{ start, end, score, text, missing, flags }], scorer and note; on a PDF the match and each passage also give pdf_page and pdf_page_end (1-based).

title: Verify that a quote appears on a web page
